answer.claimed: The lab requests repayment under NIH/NIAID grant R21AI182745, "Investigating ploidy modulation as a strategy to improve antibiotic activity," for 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31, in the total amount of $5,130. All of it is personnel cost (personnel total $5,130), and no purchases are claimed in any budget category. Personnel: a research technician at 60% effort for one pay period, $2,880, and a graduate researcher at 50% effort for one pay period, $2,250. Both roles support the project's aim of investigating ploidy modulation to improve antibiotic activity.
answer.leftOut: Held spending is left out: rq-037 (Mueller-Hinton broth, $1,460) is left out because invoice inv-037 is on hold, as it billed for 24 bottles ($2,920) while the order was for 12 bottles ($1,460). pay-R21-2026-05-3 (research associate salary, 40% effort, $2,600) is left out because the same person is charged 110% effort for the period, and salary can't be claimed above 100% until the grant manager fixes the charges.
